conventions.payload_hex: the exact payload bytes, lowercase hex; the only input
conventions.payload_text: the same bytes as UTF-8 text for reading, or null when they are not valid UTF-8 or longer than 400 bytes; never an input
conventions.defined_members: for each object of the payload, by RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to it, the members the contract defining that object names for it, as far as the case needs them: no name in a case's payload is a fold variant of a defined member left out; an object not listed has none
conventions.expected: accept, or the reason a receiver refuses the payload for
